deadline_scope: connect, send, read, stream consumption and all configured retries

mapped_settings.note: reasoning_effort uses the provider compatibility ladder (minimal->low, medium->high, xhigh->high); the requested and sent values are different and are not claimed to be equivalent
mapped_settings.service_tier: not supported by this backend; recorded, never sent

progress_watch: not applied: keep-alives are not generation progress and the provider closes a request that has not started inference after ten minutes; the total deadline is the only bound

request_params.structured_output_mode: json_object + local JSON Schema validation (the service does not accept a caller JSON Schema)
request_params.temperature: not sent (has no effect in thinking mode)
request_params.tools: not sent (tool-free contract; any tool call is rejected)

sdk: none (stdlib http.client); no implicit SDK retries exist
